title: fix(ui): avoid reactive read warnings in picker scrolling
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Opening or navigating a picker emits Solid's `STRICT_READ_UNTRACKED` warning because its scrolling effect rereads the highlighted item outside the tracking phase.

## User Impact

Keyboard selection, scrolling, search, focus, and menu layout stay the same. The picker no longer produces this reactive-read warning.

## Why This Change Was Made

Use the open state and highlighted value already captured by the effect's compute phase. Search and row changes still trigger scroll and fade updates. No new state, effect, listener, dependency, or eager import is added.

## Evidence

| Proof | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Regression on merge base `4819b0b923e8` | Keyboard wrap, scrolling, and selection passed; the warning assertion failed as expected |
| Chromium picker browser file, one worker | 18/18 passed, including the new regression |
| UI typecheck | Passed |
| Scoped formatting and lint | Passed; three existing warnings on unchanged callbacks |
| Production Knip | Passed; no new ignores |
| Isolated review | No actionable findings (P0–P2) |
| Broad UI, browser-extension, and real-Gateway proof | `ci:full` requested |
| Startup bytes, same-machine exact base/head builds and strict checks | JS: 339,543 → 339,532 B gzip (−11 B), 7 requests. CSS: 38,786 B, 1 request on both sides. Chat: −52 B; New Session: −38 B. Both passed. |

This is a nonvisual effect correction: markup, styles, classes, tags, routes, and lazy boundaries are unchanged. The browser regression exercises actual keyboard and scroll behavior; no screenshot change is claimed.

Touched production metrics (`select-picker-view.tsx`):

| Metric | Before | After |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| LOC | 605 | 604 |
| Controller references | 0 | 0 |
| `createEffect` | 3 | 3 |
| `createRenderEffect` | 0 | 0 |
| `untrack` | 3 | 3 |
| `addEventListener` | 0 | 0 |
| `querySelector` | 0 | 0 |
| Hand-built class strings | 0 | 0 |
| `flush` | 0 | 0 |
| Owner capture | 0 | 0 |

Test LOC: 546 → 578. The added case covers the actual warning plus keyboard wrap, visible scroll position, and selection through the public picker.

### Exact-head CI attribution

Run38933973964 completed on the reviewed head. All selected jobs passed except UI E2E5 and its downstream gate. The sole failing test is `Plugin skill bundle routes > opens the full bundle from installed settings without installing it` (`plugin-skills.e2e.test.ts:177`): computed `webkitLineClamp` was empty instead of `2`, on the initial description before opening a picker.

The actual tested merge `117fa4c463db` has base `cee2191da55b` and changes only the two picker files. Plugin pages, styles, fixtures, app/lib sources, build/test configuration, scripts and dependencies have identical Git objects to that base. Latest scheduled main run38932746006 passed UI E2E5, so this is recorded as a plainly unrelated source failure, not a matching-main failure or confirmed flake. Landing uses the authorized native admin route; the failing run is not relabeled green.
